name: Click
long_description:
Click builds chat-native work services for ChatGPT and Claude. 
We’re starting with a research service that brings live external context from professional & social platforms, financial markets, maps, travel sources - and a lot more - into the conversation. 
It makes research on people & companies even deeper with specialized, source-backed context beyond built-in web search, while enabling new tasks like comparing live flight fares right inside the chat.
